notes.title: Update v0.35 is now live!
notes.content:
Are you ready to enhance your creativity with object scaling? Scale your placed items up or down for even more creative freedom. Decorate to your hearts content with over 160+ new scenery objects, including themed objects to create a tranquil zen-garden look or sci-fi vibe to inspire your next game hit!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529214/b15e8088e63d9d50e43f7b33fec767e319c2d6bb.png"]

Full changelog (v.0.35)

o   Added scaling tool for object placement.

Placeable object can now be scaled up or down.

Set scale constraints to min 25% (0.25) and max 250% (2.5) of original prefab object.

Added new scaling mode and custom cursor icon during object placement.

Added shortcut (holding R) input and physical UI button to activate scaling mode.

o   Added more decoration items to place

Total new items added: 164 

Bringing the total number of total decoration items to 531

o   Changed: the sorting within the object placement menu. Will now better sort items with prefixes like _1 _2 etc.

o   Fixed: traffic system will reset properly after loading a saved file, allowing traffic vehicles to spawn again.

notes.title: GameOn! Update 3 is Live! 🚨
notes.content:
🚨Update 3 is Live! 🚨
Are you ready to take your game studio to the next step? 
[previewyoutube="IRKZHnVO_-o;full"][/previewyoutube]
3 new features just landed in GameOn! 🎮

✨ Freeform Building – Place, move, rotate & decorate with 380+ items to create your dream studio.
👀 First-Person Mode – Step inside your office and explore it up close!
⚖️ Difficulty Profiles – Easy, Medium, or Hard – play your way.

Plus tons of fixes, polish, and new details around the world.

📺 Watch the new trailer & dive in now!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529214/2fe55bec0f32287d2a63faaa159fdbd4c69d65be.png"]

Full changelog (v0.34): 

New features

o   Freeform item placement

Decorate your game studio with full creativity to make it truly yours. 

Choose from over 380+ items ranging from chairs and tables to posters, signs or electronical devices. There are also a lot of themed items included to support specific game genres or for additional seasonal decorations. 

Manipulate objects on 3 axis, including rotation and height settings. 

Use new tools to place, move, rotate, sell and reset objects. 

Use the filter categories or manual filter search bar to quickly find the object you're looking for. 

Simply un-do or re-do actions during object placement using keyboard shortcuts or on screen buttons.

Although NPC's will not interact with your placed object, they will try to find a way around your placed scenery if their path is blocked. If no path is available, they enter a state of being 'stuck', signaling you by waving their arms. When a path becomes available again, they will continue their path towards their destination. 

o   First Person Mode

Enjoy your game studio from a first person perspective. 

See your placed decorations first hand. 

o   Difficulty Profiles

When starting a new game, players are now able to chose from 3 difficulty profiles, easy, medium or hard. Each profile comes with its own starting conditions, so choose the difficulty setting that fits your play style and management experience. 



Misc. additions

Added: a new npc animation type: waving. Used when a path becomes unavailable due to object placement or if an npc becomes ‘stuck’.

Added: 2 new finance stats, 1 income (object refunds) and 1 expense (object placement). Integrated these stats with all logic and save/load system. 

Added: new UI elements in the options menu – input / control submenu to display the object placement controls.

Added: tutorial support for object placement. 

Added: additional details to the main scene scenery, e.g. traffic signs, busstop, windmills.

Added: new onscreen UI button to switch to first person mode. 

Added: when in first person mode, a crosshair will appear.

Added: scene boundries for the first person player. 

Changes

Changed: the order of the marketing and staff assign option. Added a ‘no staff selected’ default entry on the publishing options menu. Also changed the logic for the publish button in this menu. If no marketing is selected, the logic will skip the assigned staff check for marketing.

Changed: the layout of the helper HUD menu, containing the calendar and first person mode button. 

Changed: the way messages are passed on to the player throughout the game. All messages are now stored and displayed subsequentially to prevent messages not reaching the player from the HUD.

Changed: with the addition of game difficulty profiles, the starting stats have been changed, depending on the chosen profile. Stats affected are starting cash, total fans, unlocked gameplay researches and rent cost.

Bug fixes

Fixed: visual clipping of one of the tunnel sections.

Fixed: missing stat for merchandise expense in finance menu when loading of a saved file.

Fixed: an incorrect doorhinge of the marketing room door, resulting in a visual incorrect door rotation.

notes.title: Update v0.33
notes.content:
Update v0.33 is live! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529214/21286ba8a1739f0f31fbbe98ec8a693ef734b8c6.png"]
Additions

o   Added: surrounding scenery of the main level. Added 4 tunnel sections for visual hiding of the traffic system spawning and destroying vehicles.

o   Added: in the publishing options menu, the selected staff status is now visible. 

o   Added: in the publishing options menu, the selected staff can now be focused on directly. Also added a sprite of the selected NPC and a visual indicator to show the status of the selected NPC.

o   Added: in the merchandise order setup, the delivery status has been added to better visualize and indicate if a new order can be placed or not.



Changes

o   Changed: increased the threshold for merchandise sales dropping from 1 to 3 years.

o   Changed: the scenery balloon spawn and destination points to fit the scenery better.

o   Changed: minor UI changes to the project cancel confirmation panel.

o   Changed: When closing the new project menu, the name of the project will now reset properly.



Bugs and issues

o   Fixed: a bug that would allow the player to publish an empty sequel or DLC project type, crashing the game. Added a default entry of ‘no project selected’ for all project types.

o   Fixed: missing color customization functionality on some UI panels.

o   Fixed: a bug preventing other staff members then the main player character to print a game report.

o   Fixed: correct a visual clipping issue with a monitor object in the marketing room.

o   Fixed: a bug where the server capacities were set incorrectly when loading a saved file.

notes.title: Update 1 is out now! New feature: merchandise
notes.content:
Update 1 is out now! Bringing you a merchandise feature
Update 1 introduces a brand new major feature: merchandise! 

You are now able to research the 'merchandise' option from your research tab. When researched, you are

able to sell merchandise items for your released game projects. Selling merchandise will increase your income and requires additional management to handle your storage capacity. 

Be careful not to order too much stock, or risk having to sell at a discount or destroy your stock directly. 




[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529214/1bfe3cf8276ab9ba014bb1068080dacba9bdd649.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529214/03b45f6efad3af7cea6006fa425b21878922b5c9.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529214/30cc6d77090ca8cd988567756726d175e7b5df02.png"][/carousel]
Full changelog / release notes: 

Brand new feature: merchandise. 

You are able to order and resell the following items: Mugs, t-shirts, themed figurines, keyrings, posters, mousepads, stickers, and plushy toys. 

Added a new research to your research tab, called 'merchandise'. 

Added a new income and expenses entry in the finances menu. 

Added a brand new delivery system that will periodically deliver outstanding orders. 

Added a new delivery company (SSS: sorta swift shipping) with a delivery vehicle and 2 staff variations (male and female). 

Added multiple new UI menu's to see, order and manage your stock. 

Added a dynamic customer feedback system to visualize how your items are selling on the market. 

See your storage grow with every delivery! The current stock capacity is represented visually inside your storage. Increasing or decreasing merchandise boxes across multiple shelfs. 

Micromanage your stock! You are able to select a price range for every ordered item and individually activate a discount to increase your sales. 

Older games (based on release year) will sell poorly at full price or not at all. This requires additional planning, management and introduces additional financial and logistical risks. 

Sales are directly affected by the number of fans you currently have. More fans means a broader sales market to sell your products. 

Filter your merchandise content easily by searching on a specific feature. This will be especially handy in longer play sessions with lots of items in game. 

Changed: the small loan is now available by default when starting a new game. No need to research it anymore for a better financial balance for players when starting a new game. 

Fixed: the storefront income value is now properly saved when saving a game. 

Fixed: a missing reference for the storefront research button, preventing it to update correctly when staff are busy and the research tab was open. 

Fixed: a bug where the game would auto-save after being 'game over'. This causes the latest save file to be unplayable. 

Fixed: other small quality of life improvements and minor balancing of stats.
